{{Quote|Berry&hellip;wine of some&hellip;sort. Goldenrod about split a resistor translating, but the gist of what the fuzzy guy said was, ''"To ignite the heart that's beginning to warm."''|Han Solo about the berry wine|<ref name="TTAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>}}
'''Berry wine'''  was an alcoholic beverage made from berries. It was cloudy, [[Color/Legends|purple]] in color, and sweet-tasting.<ref name="TTAB" />

Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] received several bottles of berry wine from an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] medicine man on the forest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] after the Ewok tribe made Solo and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] honorary members. According to the Ewok, the wine was intended ''"to ignite the heart that's beginning to warm."'' While aboard his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], Solo opened a bottle and offered Organa a cup of the wine. She took a sip and remarked that it was too sweet.<ref name="TTAB" />
